seo.homeFaq7A: Babu asusu da ake bukata. FreeTV Garden baya neman imel, kalmar sirri, ko kowane bayanan sirri don kallo.
seo.homeFaq8A: Ee — FreeTV Garden yana gudana a cikin kowane burauzar wayar hannu ta zamani akan Android ko iPhone, kuma ana iya ƙarawa zuwa allon gida don samun dama ta taɓawa ɗaya (duba sashin shigarwa a sama).
seo.homeFaq9A: Tashoshi rafi ne kai tsaye da aka samo su daga masu watsa shirye-shiryen jama'a, don haka wasu suna yin layi na ɗan lokaci saboda matsalar uwar garke. Gwada wata tashar, ko duba baya daga baya - yawancin suna dawowa cikin 'yan mintuna zuwa sa'o'i.
seo.homeFaq10Q: Shin rafukan sun halatta a kalla?
seo.homeFaq10A: FreeTV Garden yana tattara rafukan raye-raye na jama'a - da farko daga littafin al'umma na iptv-org - kuma baya ɗaukan ko adana duk fayilolin bidiyo da kanta. Duba sashin Shari'a & Tsaro a ƙasa don ƙarin.
seo.homeFaqMore: Ana amsa ƙarin tambayoyi akan cikakken {link1} .
seo.homeLegal: FreeTV Garden yana tattara rafukan kai tsaye na jama'a daga kyauta, kafofin jama'a, gami da kundin adireshin al'umma iptv-org. Ba ya ɗaukar nauyin ko adana kowane bidiyo ko fayilolin mai jiwuwa, kuma baya buƙatar asusu don amfani da shi.
